items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
items.computation: Letter dated 11.03.2025, no separate posting date, so posting day = 11.03.2025. Pension insurer = social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed delivery on the 4th day after posting (posted after 1 Jan 2025) = Sat 15.03.2025; for social-law bodies the delivery day does not move. Period of one month starts the day after delivery (16.03.2025) and ends on the same day number one month later = Tue 15.04.2025. That is a working day and not a public holiday in NW, so no adjustment.
